summary: Surrounds the target in a shell of fresh air, allowing survival in hostile environments.
Allows the caster to assume the shape of another humanoid creature, altering appearance but not abilities.
Creates an auditory illusion of choir music that inspires allies and unnerves foes.
Animates dead remains as obedient skeletons or zombies. Animate up to 2 x caster level Hit Dice of undead per casting.
Creates a personal barrier that blocks spells and spell-like effects from entering or leaving.
Removes the burden of unwilling evil acts from the subject and may reverse magical alignment change.
Reveals whether a contemplated action will bring good or bad results within the next 3 turns.
Grants the caster and allies +1 on attack throws, damage rolls, morale rolls, and saving throws against magical fear.
Produces a cone of searing flame from the caster's hands.
Calls a dragon into the caster's service for the duration.
Allows the caster to call lightning bolts from a nearby storm, dealing damage to targets.
Allows the target to blend into surroundings, becoming nearly invisible while stationary.
Charms an animal in a manner similar to charm person; lasts until removed by dispel magic or a successful saving throw.
Functions like charm person without restriction by type or size; affects up to 3d6 HD of creatures of 4 or fewer HD, or one creature of more.
Makes the target regard the caster as a trusted friend and ally, interpreting words and actions favorably.
Creates a visual and auditory illusion of an object, creature, or force.
Creates an invisible grip around the target's throat, dealing damage each round unless the target saves.
Allows the caster to hear sounds in another area through a living creature in that area.
Lets the caster see into another area through the eyes of a living creature there.
Creates a moving cloud of poisonous gas that spreads 20' per round away from the caster.
Commands animals within range to perform actions the caster directs.
Commands persons within range to perform actions the caster directs while the caster concentrates.
Commands plants and plant-like creatures to perform actions the caster directs.
Compels the target to obey a single-word command to the best of its ability.
Puts the caster in contact with a divine power that answers 3 yes-or-no questions.
Causes affected creatures to roll on a confusion behavior table each round, losing independent action.
Produces a chilling cone of cold energy dealing 1d4+1 damage per caster level.
Produces a cone that paralyzes all creatures in the area unless they save vs. Paralysis.
Opens a portal to an Elemental Plane and summons an Air, Earth, Fire, or Water elemental that serves while the caster concentrates.
Conjures oozes from a primordial sphere of existence to serve the caster.
Sends the caster's mind to another plane to ask brief questions of extraplanar powers.
Creates a sustained sphere of light equivalent to full daylight; may be cast on an object, into the air, or at a creature.
Controls animals as if using charm monster for the duration.
Controls plants or plant-like creatures within range, directing their movement and actions.
Controls undead despite their normal immunity to charm effects.
Creates a chosen weather condition around the caster; duration is indefinite while stationary and concentrating.
Manipulates airflow within range, increasing or decreasing wind speed.
Creates simple nourishing food sufficient for 12 men and their mounts for 1 day.
Creates an enchanted spring providing enough water for 12 men and their mounts for 1 day.
Cures blindness caused by injury or magic, including blindness from light or continual light.
Heals a large amount of damage by touch; restores 3d6+3 hit points.
Cures all diseases including lycanthropy and mummy rot, and kills green slime and parasites.
Restores 1d6+1 hit points by touch, or cures paralysis instead.
Heals significant damage by touch; restores 2d6+2 hit points.
Heals moderate damage by touch; restores 1d6+1 hit points plus 1 per level.
Restores 2d6 hit points plus 1 per caster level by touch.
Transforms targets into pigs for the duration unless they succeed on a saving throw.
Kills up to 4d8 Hit Dice of creatures in the area, weakest creatures dying first.
Protects the target from death-related magic such as death spells, energy drain, and death effects.
Animates one dead creature as a temporary skeleton or zombie under spoken command.
Temporarily halts the progress of a disease for 24 hours without curing it.
Delays the effects of poison rather than curing it; the subject is temporarily immune to poison during the spell.
Reveals creatures affected by charm-like magic within range.
Reveals cursed items and areas within range.
Determines whether an examined target creature or object is dangerous.
Detects evil intentions, evil-enchanted items, undead, sinkholes of evil, and summoned chaotic creatures.
Allows the caster to see invisible characters, creatures, and objects as translucent shapes.
Lets the caster see enchanted or enspelled objects and creatures as pale glowing yellow light.
Reveals whether a target creature, object, or area is poisoned or poisonous.
Detects ritual spellcasting occurring within range for the duration.
Detects secret doors within range.
Detects undead creatures within range.
Instantly transports the subject to any spot within 360' of the caster's or target's current location.
Projects a ray that disintegrates the target into fine dust; carried equipment is unaffected.
Maims and dismembers the target, dealing damage and potentially causing a mortal wound.
Radiates destructive holy power; undead and enchanted creatures entering within 30' must save or be destroyed.
Ends ongoing spells and spell-like effects on a creature or within an area.
Provides useful advice regarding a specific goal, event, or activity expected within 1 week.
Grants a bonus to saving throws equal to the caster's Charisma modifier.
Pillars of jagged rock erupt from the ground and impale selected targets in the area.
Creates a nondimensional storage space inside a small container that holds far more than its size suggests.
Strikes the target with negative energy, temporarily reducing ability scores.
Totally enslaves the target to the caster's will until dispelled.
Captures the attention of listeners and holds them spellbound while the caster performs.
Lets the caster detect the surface thoughts of one or more targets, understood regardless of language.
Greatly increases the target's visual range, allowing sight at distances normally impossible.
Outlines creatures or objects in pale flickering fire, granting +2 to all attacks against an outlined target.
Grants prophetic insight into a particular character's future, revealing a significant event that will occur.
Forces creatures in a cone to flee in fear unless they succeed on a saving throw.
Reduces the subject to helpless idiocy; the target cannot cast spells, understand language, or communicate coherently.
Places the subject in a death-like paralytic arrest that mimics death to any observer.
Alters others' social reactions; creatures failing their save treat the caster as though Charisma were 2d4 points higher.
Detects magical and mechanical traps; when within 30' of a trap, it glows with a faint blue aura.
Senses the direction to the most valuable treasure within range.
Creates an explosion of flame dealing 1d6 fire damage per caster level to every creature in the area.
Calls down a column of divine fire dealing 6d8 damage in a 30' high by 10' diameter area.
Turns the target and all carried gear into an inert stone statue permanently.
Creates an invisible 3' concave plane of force carrying up to 50 stone (500 lb) that follows the caster.
Allows the subject to fly freely at up to 120' per round in any direction.
Seals an area against extradimensional beings and extradimensional travel.
Transforms the subject into a translucent cloud of gas that can pass through small openings.
Places a magical command on the target to perform or avoid a course of action.
Temporarily grants the subject the strength of a hill giant, increasing damage and attack ability.
Covers the area in glowing dust that blinds creatures and outlines hidden or invisible creatures.
Prevents spells and spell effects of up to 4th level from penetrating the globe.
Creates an almost invisible magical ward on a surface that harms intruders who lack the password.
Doubles the recipient's size, increasing strength, reach, and weapon damage.
Enlarges an animal to twice normal size and eight times normal weight, dealing double damage with attacks.
Causes normal vegetation to become thick and overgrown into an impassable thicket.
Creates a strong blast of air that can extinguish flames, scatter small objects, and knock down creatures.
Makes outdoor terrain appear to be a different natural terrain type, looking, sounding, and smelling authentic.
Speeds up affected creatures so they move and act twice as quickly, with doubled movement and attacks.
Paralyzes a living creature of any type, functioning like hold person but without the humanoid restriction.
Paralyzes the target while leaving awareness and breathing intact; paralyzed targets cannot act or speak.
Magically holds a portal shut, treating it as securely closed and normally locked.
Continuous chant grants allies +1 to attack throws, damage rolls, and saving throws while penalizing enemies by -1.
Mesmerizes creatures that see the pattern, rendering them unable to act while they watch it.
Makes the target move and fight noiselessly until they attack or cast a spell.
Grants the subject the ability to see in the dark to 60'.
Summons a controllable plague of swarming insects consisting of 4 insect swarms with 4 HD each.
Makes the touched creature or object invisible including to infravision; ends when the target attacks.
Functions like invisibility but affects all creatures within 10' of the recipient; affected creatures see each other.
Summons an invisible stalker to perform the caster's bidding until the task is complete or it is slain.
Protects the caster from normal, non-magical attacks by evil creatures.
Grants the recipient prodigious leaping ability, allowing jumps of 30' forward or 10' vertically.
Opens one means of preventing access â€” a locked or held door, chest, or shackle.
Moves the subject vertically up or down by concentration at up to 20' per round.
Creates torch-equivalent magical light on an object or point; may also blind a creature on a failed save.
Releases a line of electrical energy dealing 1d6 damage per caster level to all in its path.
Reveals the direction to the closest specimen of a named animal or plant type within range.
Senses the direction of a well-known or clearly visualized object within range.
Makes the touched creature 10 years younger, potentially removing some effects of aging.
Lowers water or similar liquid in a large area, potentially exposing the bottom.
Transforms a suitable carpet into a flying vehicle under the caster's command.
Transfers the caster's soul into a receptacle, then allows possession of the body of a nearby creature.
Creates unerring missiles of magical energy that automatically hit their target, dealing 1d6+1 damage each.
Places a conditional speaking mouth on a non-living object that delivers a message when triggered.
Enchants rope to move on command and support up to 10,000 cn (1,000 lb) of weight.
Grants multiple subjects infravision to 60' for one day.
Conceals up to 100 man-sized creatures by making them appear to be natural terrain features.
Prevents 1st, 2nd, and 3rd level spells or spell effects from penetrating the globe.
Creates 1d4 illusory duplicates of the caster that confuse attackers; attacks against caster may hit an image instead.
Moves large volumes of soil and can alter surface features such as hills, ditches, and earthworks.
Imbues the caster with necromantic power and temporary hit points drawn from negative energy.
Detoxifies venom in a creature or object, neutralizing all poison effects.
Protects the target from crystal balls and any type of ESP or divination magic.
Condemns the touched creature to oblivion if it fails its saving throw vs. Spells.
Creates a harmless mist that blocks line of sight for most creatures within the area.
Grants the subject the strength and prowess of an ogre for the duration.
Causes affected creatures to drop everything and flee in blind panic unless they save.
Allows the recipient to move without leaving evidence of passage â€” no tracks, scent, or trail.
Creates a temporary passage through rock, earth, or similar solid material.
Creates a permanent multi-sensory illusion of an object, creature, or force.
Creates a visual illusion of an object, creature, or force; disbelieved on interaction.
Creates an illusion of the target's greatest fear that attacks; target must save or die from fright.
Permanently transforms a target into another living creature form of the caster's choice.
Transforms the caster into another living creature form, gaining physical traits but not special abilities.
Grants allies a +1 bonus to attack throws, damage rolls, and saving throws, and penalizes enemies by -1.
Accurately predicts the weather within range for the next 12 hours.
Creates a small flame in the caster's palm that can be used to ignite combustibles.
Places a multi-sensory illusion that activates on a specified trigger condition.
Creates a quasi-real illusory version of the caster that can cast spells as the caster.
Creates a stationary protective barrier granting +1 to AC and saving throws against evil creatures.
Functions as protection from evil with a fixed sustained duration of 12 turns.
Completely protects the subject from small non-magical missile attacks.
Completely protects the subject from normal, non-magical weapon attacks.
Makes contaminated food and water safe for consumption; enough for up to 12 people.
Places a magical command requiring or forbidding a course of action; failure to comply causes ill effects.
Allows reading of almost any written language or script for the duration.
Heals permanent wounds and regenerates lost body parts; the subject regains 1 hit point per round.
Returns a dead character to life in a newly created young adult body of a random race and class.
Removes curses from creatures and frees creatures from cursed items.
Calms the touched creature and removes fear; reversed form causes a target to flee in fear.
Grants temporary resistance and immunity to cold effects for the duration.
Grants temporary resistance and immunity to fire and heat for the duration.
Restores life to the recently dead and repairs permanent bodily damage including lost limbs.
Imbues subjects with righteous wrath, granting a bonus to attack throws and damage against enemies of the faith.
Improves natural healing during complete rest, doubling hit points recovered.
Forces direct attackers to save vs. Spells or be unable to attack the warded creature.
Creates a damaging blast of wind and debris with additional effects based on creature size.
Shows images of distant creatures, objects, or places through a scrying device.
Creates a mobile invisible force shield providing AC 2 against missiles and AC 4 against melee attacks.
Surrounds the caster with a protective shimmering aura that reduces damage taken.
Creates complete silence in a 15' radius area, preventing sound and spellcasting that requires speech.
Allows the touched character to move almost noiselessly.
Allows the caster to assume the form of a normal or giant animal.
Puts eligible creatures of low HD into magical slumber; affects a total Hit Dice based on the table.
Makes a character, object, or floor nearly impossible to grasp, hold, or stand on.
Instantly destroys undead up to a Hit Dice total equal to the caster's level; reversed form animates dead.
Makes snakes indifferent to the caster and those near the caster.
Lets the caster communicate with animals, asking questions and receiving answers.
Animates a corpse enough to answer questions about its life, knowledge, or possessions.
Lets the caster communicate with plants, asking questions and receiving simple answers.
Creates a movable multi-sensory illusion of an object, creature, or force.
Prepares an item to hold up to six spells that can be triggered by a designated bearer.
Negates invisibility and similar concealment effects within a 20' radius sphere.
Allows the recipient to climb vertical surfaces and hang from ceilings as a spider.
Creates a healing force the caster directs each round, restoring hit points to a chosen target.
Creates a force weapon that attacks once per round using the caster's attack throw bonus.
Creates foul vapors that render creatures within the cloud helpless with nausea unless they save.
Transforms up to 2d8 sticks into normal snakes under the caster's command.
Improves the target's saving throws by +4 for the duration.
Empowers a weapon with extra magical damage, dealing an additional 1d6 damage per hit.
Summons normal animals within range to aid the caster, answering the call if in the area.
Summons 4 berserkers from another sphere of existence to fight for the caster.
Summons a djinni to serve and obey the summoner for one day.
Summons a specified fantastic creature to the caster's service for the duration.
Summons a 4th level fighter hero from another sphere of existence to serve the caster.
Pulls a nearby weather condition to the caster's location within 1 turn.
Calls a pegasus to serve as a winged steed for one day.
Doubles the caster's normal number of attacks per round with a melee weapon.
Creates a magical flaming sword in the caster's hand dealing extra fire damage.
Moves objects or creatures by concentration, up to 200 cn per caster level.
Reads the thoughts of a creature within range and allows two-way telepathic communication.
Instantly transports the subject to a designated destination; accuracy depends on familiarity.
Allows understanding and speaking the language of any intelligent creature within range.
Puts an undead creature into indefinite pseudo-sleep until awakened.
Places the caster in a deep trance that detects specific supernatural presences within range.
Changes natural rock into mud, creating difficult terrain and potentially trapping creatures.
Grants troll-like regeneration, recovering 3 hit points per round.
Allows the subject to see things as they really are within 120', piercing illusions and concealment.
Violently whirls a target through the air, dealing damage and allowing the caster to fling it.
Creates an invisible mindless shapeless servant that performs simple tasks for the caster.
Makes the caster's voice seem to originate from any location within range.
Temporarily enhances the subject's resilience, granting bonus hit points and increased strength.
Conjures a durable wall of writhing animated corpses that can attack adjacent creatures.
Creates an immobile opaque wall of violet flame that deals fire damage to those who pass through.
Creates an invisible impenetrable wall of force that cannot be dispelled or damaged.
Creates an immobile translucent wall of ice that deals cold damage to creatures breaking through.
Creates a flat vertical wall of iron up to 3' thick and 500 sq ft in area.
Creates an immobile opaque wall of smoke that blocks line of sight.
Creates a shaped stone wall up to 2' thick and 1,000 sq ft in area.
Brings a wooden wall into existence, up to 6' thick and 500 sq ft in area.
Warps and bends wooden weapons, wands, and staffs, rendering them useless.
Allows the affected creature to breathe underwater at any depth for one day.
Allows the subject to walk on water as though it were solid dry land.
Creates a mass of sticky strands that entangles creatures; creatures of 3+ HD may break free over time.
Grants the caster large wings and the ability to fly at 120' per round.
Creates an invisible magical eye through which the caster can see while concentrating.
Magically locks a door, chest, or portal; can only be opened by the caster, knock, or dispel magic.
Allows the caster to see through solid material up to 10' thick while concentrating.
